closedProjection: aria-expanded=false; panel unmounted by default, or hidden/noninteractive if the source keepMounted option is explicitly chosen.
semantics: First panel content
keyboardAndFocus: Base UI 1.9 uses normal Tab order and native Enter/Space on each trigger. Its orientation/loopFocus props are deprecated and no longer implement roving/arrow focus. Arrow/Home/End are not invented as accordion selection commands.
sourceRule: multiple=false permits at most one expanded item; pressing that item closes it. multiple=true toggles items independently. Disabled root/items suppress changes. The callback candidate may be canceled; controlled value stays prop-authoritative.
protocol: SCXML consumes source-normalized interaction/callback transactions. eventDetails is the source callback object. onOpenChange/onValueChange sends project those observed callbacks, never dispatch a second DOM event. _effect.* entries are internal source focus/application effects, not public component events. Controlled SET_OPEN/SET_VALUE synchronizes props without fabricating a callback.
actualModalityProjection: The pinned Base UI implementation does not emit aria-modal by default. Its modal prop owns focus containment and outside aria-hidden/inert behavior. This source reference does not invent an aria-modal attribute; it is not a universal ARIA conformance certificate.
ownership: Trigger/popup IDs, labels and descriptions belong to this exact instance. Modal ownership cannot be inferred from edge placement or shared globally across unrelated popups.
